title: Sparsity Should Be ALLOTted by Output: Training-Free Allocation of Block-Sparse Attention for Video Diffusion Transformers
title_zh: 稀疏度应由输出分配：面向视频扩散Transformer的无训练块稀疏注意力分配

paragraphs.en: 提出ALLOT免训练块稀疏注意力分配方法，在视频扩散Transformer上显著提升保真度并降低延迟。 Full 3D attention is costly in video Diffusion Transformers. Block-sparse attention reduces this cost by computing only selected attention blocks. However, existing methods either overlook the potential to optimize sparsity allocation or rely on heuristic rules or local metrics to guide it. In this work, we observe that sparsifying attention in different layers and at different denoising steps affects final-video fidelity to substantially different degrees. Yet the identities of the most sensitive layer-step pairs remain nearly unchanged across inputs. Building on these findings, we propose Allocating Layer-step Latency by Output Tests (ALLOT), a training-free sparsity allocation method. Treating each layer-step pair as a cell, ALLOT estimates each cell's contribution to final-video error through (i) cell probing and (ii) trajectory calibration, then jointly optimizes cell densities under a measured-latency budget. It preserves existing selection strategies and kernels, replacing only the allocation component. At equal or shorter wall-clock time, ALLOT outperforms every compared allocation strategy with XAttention, with an 11.8 dB PSNR gain on HunyuanVideo. Extensive experiments across four additional published pipelines on Wan2.1, Wan2.2, and HunyuanVideo show that ALLOT outperforms or ties the default in all nine settings.
paragraphs.zh: 提出ALLOT免训练块稀疏注意力分配方法，在视频扩散Transformer上显著提升保真度并降低延迟。视频扩散Transformer中的完整3D注意力代价高昂。 块稀疏注意力通过仅计算被选中的注意力块来降低这一开销。 然而，现有方法要么忽视了优化稀疏度分配的潜力，要么依赖启发式规则或局部指标来指导分配。 在本工作中，我们观察到，对不同层、不同去噪步骤中的注意力进行稀疏化，对最终视频保真度的影响程度存在显著差异。 然而，最敏感的层-步骤对的身份在不同输入之间几乎保持不变。 基于这些发现，我们提出通过输出测试分配层-步骤延迟（ALLOT），一种免训练的稀疏度分配方法。 ALLOT将每个层-步骤对视为一个单元，通过（i）单元探测和（ii）轨迹校准来估计每个单元对最终视频误差的贡献，然后在实测延迟预算下联合优化各单元的密度。 它保留了现有的选择策略和核，仅替换分配组件。 在相同或更短的墙钟时间下，ALLOT在所有对比的XAttention分配策略中表现最优，在HunyuanVideo上取得了11.8 dB的PSNR增益。 在Wan2.1、Wan2.2和HunyuanVideo上另外四个已发布流水线的大量实验表明，ALLOT在全部九种设置中均优于或持平默认方法。
